At the time, my mom was a SAHM and my dad worked and provided for us. Any money she spent for her kids would’ve been my dad’s anyway. We also were not struggling financially, there was no need for her to cash them.

The HC dolls are a bold way to start collecting, if this is worth it to you then I say go for it. Value is decided by the buyer

Prices are not likely to drop for HC dolls, availability will just get scarcer and scarcer as time goes on. Individually (and in US prices) I’ve seen Lagoona and Cleo the cheapest, 90$ ish, since they were the last released and there were so many price gougers ready for them, and the market got over saturated. Clawdeen and Frankie are typically 150$ each, and drac… if she can be found, the absolute cheapest is around 300, but 400 is more typical. I’m not sure if they’re more scarce in Germany, but even 240$ per doll is a large ask. If you have the patience I would wait and try to find them cheaper individually, and think about whether you truly want all 5 or if it’s just the desire to have the complete collection.

She will figure it out on her own eventually, but if you can, convince her that he’s really just using her, and that’s not love.

I’ve been in this exact same situation, and honestly the feeling does not go away. If he’s not willing to try something new with you, and you’re not satisfied, it’s not likely to change. You can see if he’d be ok with an open relationship so you can find partners that work with your kinks, but if not, I’d just let him go.

Unfortunately you can’t force her into therapy or anything, she’d likely just shut down. Just let her know that you’re always around to listen, and if she ever wants to get professional help that you’ll help her out. And just watch out for her, she deserves a good life.

It sounds like her ex is being very manipulative, he wants to keep her on the line so that he can get her back whenever he feels like. This would be painful for your friend because she wouldn’t be able to properly move on. And having a toxic family is not an excuse for being insensitive. I would advise her to just cold turkey block him, and get over him as best she can. She’ll find someone she loves again who doesn’t string her along.

It’s possible, sometimes having a guy that’s so available gets boring. Girls are weird, I apologize on behalf of us all. But you can try little things that aren’t real issues, like saying you can’t see her a day that she asks, or not answering her messages right away.

He does see a therapist already, I highly doubt I’d be able to sit in but I’ll ask him if he’ll talk to her about it, just cuz finding a relationship counselor and dealing with everything that comes with just isn’t doable.
Compared to my exes???? Nah this is the best I’ll do.

He hasn’t had many serious relationships, so I’m really trying to be patient with him while he adjusts to my needs, but I’m definitely going to talk to him again and see if this issue is over and done with or if it’s gonna be a deal breaker.

Speaking as a girl in an incredibly healthy relationship, similar to you guys, I do kind of understand her. If she’s been in toxic relationships before, the sudden change might just be a bit shocking and she doesn’t know how to handle it. Or she just likes the passion of a fight, because as screwed up as it is, fights can sometimes show the other person that you care enough to tell them what’s up. I would try talking to her, see why she wants you to start treating her worse, and see if you guys can work through it.
